parameters.query:
SELECT 
  u.id AS user_id,
  u.email AS user_email,
  u.name AS user_name,
  u.profession,
  s.status AS subscription_status,
  s.current_period_end,
  COALESCE(st.report_time, '08:00') AS report_time,
  COALESCE(st.timezone, 'Asia/Kolkata') AS timezone,
  d.reports_folder_id,
  d.status AS drive_status
FROM public.users u
INNER JOIN public.subscriptions s ON s.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN public.user_settings st ON st.user_id = u.id
LEFT JOIN public.google_drive_connections d ON d.user_id = u.id
WHERE 
  ({{ $json.userId ? "u.id = '" + $json.userId + "'" : '1=1' }})
  AND (s.status = 'active' OR (s.status = 'cancelled' AND s.current_period_end > now()))
  -- Timezone-aware hour match (e.g. '09' matches '09:00', '9:00', etc.)
  AND (
    {{ $json.isWebhook }} 
    OR LPAD(TRIM(SPLIT_PART(COALESCE(st.report_time, '08:00'), ':', 1)), 2, '0') = TO_CHAR(now() AT TIME ZONE COALESCE(st.timezone, 'Asia/Kolkata'), 'HH24')
  );
